## Walkcast 0.10.7

### Fixed

- Linux desktop installations now use Tauri's signed `.AppImage.tar.gz` updater bundle. The release workflow publishes the bundle and its signature, so Linux users can update in place without downloading a replacement AppImage.
- Settings puts the signed updater first and explains that desktop updates install in place. A ready release can be installed with one click; reinstalling the installer is not the normal update path.

### SEO and citations

- Added a ranked query-to-page map based on the repository's autocomplete research, with evidence limits, source links and crawl-measurement steps.
- Refreshed cited comparison prices against vendor pricing pages and dated the facts checked on 5 November 2026.
- Removed unsupported GEO citation multipliers and clarified that technical eligibility does not guarantee crawl, index, rank or citation.
